errorCodes.meaning: The document's `type` is not in this task's table of host-bound room requests, so the recipient will not sign it as the member. `details.type` repeats it.
The recipient holds no credential issued by the document's room to a member its caller may act as.

The document's `issuer` is absent and the recipient cannot tell which member to act as: the caller may act as more than one member of the document's room, or the document's type names no room (a download chunk, a direct upload's commit or abort), for which `issuer` is the only way to name the member. Name the member in `issuer` and ask again.

The document's `issuer` is not a member the recipient may act as for its caller: for a type that names a room, not a member of that room the caller may act as; for a type that names no room, not a member whose keys the recipient holds and the caller may act as. `details.issuer` repeats it.
The member's own credentials do not confer the action the document's type requires. `details.action` names it.

The document is a vtc/rooms/offers/accept carrying a `keyPackage` the recipient did not mint for this room and this member with rooms/keys/key-package, or one whose private half it no longer holds (used, or expired). Mint one with rooms/keys/key-package and build the acceptance with it (Recipient item 10).

The document is a rooms/epoch/mint for a room whose MLS group the recipient holds. A sealed room's epoch advances only with a commit of its group, which a client cannot make, and a mint without one leaves every member's key holder behind the host. Renew a sealed room with rooms/owner/group/renew, which the owner's key holder performs.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

Response.description: Success response to rooms/keys/act. Type https://trusttasks.org/spec/rooms/keys/act/0.8#response. The request, completed as the member, for the caller to send to its recipient unaltered.

document.description: The supplied document with `issuer` set to the member, `payload.presentation` inserted where the type takes one, and the member's Data Integrity `proof` (`proofPurpose: authentication`). Every other member is unchanged.

expiresAt.description: When the inserted presentation's leaf lapses. Absent when the type takes no presentation.

principal.description: The member the recipient signed as: the completed document's `issuer`.

Response.title: Rooms Keys Act — response payload

UnsignedRoomRequest.description: A Trust Task document of a type in the rooms/keys/act table, built by the member's client: no proof, and no presentation in its payload. The recipient validates the payload against the named type's own schema; this one fixes only the envelope.

id.description: The request's identifier, set by the client. The host keys duplicate-execution protection on it.

issuer.description: The member to act as, and this task's subject (subjectPath /document/issuer). REQUIRED for a type that names no room (rooms/blobs/chunk/0.1, rooms/blobs/upload/{commit,abort}/0.2), where it is the member whose request opened the transfer; REQUIRED for the community types (vtc/rooms/offers/list/0.1, 0.2, 0.3 and 0.4, vtc/rooms/offers/accept/0.1, vtc/rooms/memberships/list/0.1), where it is the DID the community addressed its offers to; REQUIRED where the caller may act as more than one member of the room; optional where it may act as exactly one. A rule over two members this schema does not express: the recipient refuses an absent issuer it needs with principalAmbiguous. Never the client's own identifier.

payload.description: The request's payload, as the named type's schema defines it but without `presentation`: the recipient inserts the member's own, narrowed to the table's action, where the type takes one, and refuses a payload that already carries one. For vtc/rooms/offers/accept/0.1 a `keyPackage`, where present, MUST be one the recipient minted with rooms/keys/key-package at 0.1 or 0.2 (Recipient item 10).

recipient.description: The room's host, or for the community types the community that made the offers: the party the completed document is for. Covered by the member's proof.

type.description: The room request's Type URI: a rooms/* request, or one of the community types: vtc/rooms/offers/{list,accept} or vtc/rooms/memberships/list. Only the types in this task's table are completed; any other is `typeNotActable`.

schema.description: A member's own client asks the member's key holder to complete one host-bound room request — or one of the two requests by which a member takes up a community's offer of admission to a room — as the member: the member's own authority narrowed to the one action the request's type needs, the member as issuer, and the member's signature. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

document.description: The room request to complete, as the client will send it, minus its presentation and its proof.
